description: I'm a Game Development & Computer Science student building a mission simulator for this challenge. Players will manage a Moon or Mars outpost, balancing power, life support, radiation protection, and food production. I'm starting solo and looking to form a committed team. I can contribute Unity/C# development and gameplay design. Looking for teammates in programming, UI/UX, 2D/3D art, space/STEM research, or educational storytelling. Beginners ready to learn and build are welcome.
